answer_verbatim:
For **shadow work**, the strongest options in your results are the **Jung Platform** courses, **Awake Academy’s “Embracing the Shadow”**, and **ManTalks’ Shadow Course** because they appear more structured and closer to Jungian shadow-work practice than the typical short self-help course listing.[2][9][16][19][20]

For **spiritual practice**, the best fit in the results is the **Udemy Shadow Work Course and Workbook**, since it explicitly includes *meditations, prayers, and practices* alongside introspective work.[15]

A practical short list:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow / Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** | Learning the foundations of shadow work | It is framed as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of Jung Platform’s Jungian psychology offerings.[2][9][16] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** | Guided transformation with a spiritual edge | It is presented as a transformative course and is taught by Charlie Morley on Awake Academy.[19] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** | A longer guided process | It offers an 8-week guided process for facing and integrating the shadow.[20] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Combining shadow work with spiritual practice | It includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for introspective and spiritual transformation.[15] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | A beginner-friendly entry point | It promises shadow integration, hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |

If you want the **best overall academic/Jungian choice**, start with **Jung Platform**.[2][9][16] If you want the **most explicitly spiritual** option from the results, choose **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** on Udemy.[15]

A few notes on quality:
- The search results do **not** provide full independent reviews or instructor credentials for every course, so the “best” choice depends on whether you want *Jungian theory, guided practice, or spiritual exercises*.[1][2][15][19]
- Some Udemy listings are broad and marketing-heavy, so I would prioritize courses with clearer structure, duration, and institutional framing, like Jung Platform or Awake Academy.[2][9][19][20]
- If you prefer live interaction, **Catherine Liggett’s Shadow Work 101** is a **5-week live online course via Zoom**, which may be better than a self-paced course if you want accountability.[8]
